title: RNA-seq of PBMCs isolated from patients with various cancers and COVID-19 infection status
description: This experiment aims to understand transcriptomic signatures associated with COVID-19 infected individuals with cancer. Samples were taken before the third dose of the COVID-19 mRNA vaccination and examined differences between samples with a breakthrough infection versus without breakthrough infection, as well as subjects with haematological malignancies versus solid tumours. The results found that cancer patients with haematological malignancies are at increased risk of breakthrough infections.

samples.title: CVA053_3_P7
samples.description: Protocols: Whole blood was collected and stored at -80°C. Samples were incubated at room temperature for 2 hours prior to RNA extraction.  PAXgene Blood RNA Kit (Qiagen, 762174) was used to isolate RNA from blood. The NEBNext Globin and rRNA Depletion Kit (NEB, E7775X) was used to deplete globin and rRNA from 300ng of total RNA. NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit (NEB, E7775L) was used to construct the RNA libraries. HT DNA Extended Range LabChip (Perkin Elmer, 760517) was used to verify the library sizes and concentration, as well as pool to equal concentrations prior to sequencing.

samples.description: Protocols: Whole blood was collected and stored at -80°C. Samples were incubated at room temperature for 2 hours prior to RNA extraction.  PAXgene Blood RNA Kit (Qiagen, 762174) was used to isolate RNA from blood. The NEBNext Globin and rRNA Depletion Kit (NEB, E7775X) was used to deplete globin and rRNA from 300ng of total RNA. NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit (NEB, E7775L) was used to construct the RNA libraries. HT DNA Extended Range LabChip (Perkin Elmer, 760517) was used to verify the library sizes and concentration, as well as pool to equal concentrations prior to sequencing.
